label: RETROSPECTIVE chronological backtest; 2025 had been examined in earlier experiments; not an untouched independent test
protocol:
Retrospective chronological backtest: train on targets <= 2024-12-31, freeze, evaluate calendar year 2025.

RETROSPECTIVE: 2025 data had been examined in earlier experiments, so this is NOT an untouched independent test.
No tuning on 2025: production recipe (fte.OLD_PARAMS, V1/V2 feature sets, hybrid router, seed 42) is reused unchanged.
Production code is imported read-only; nothing outside experiments/backtest_2025/ is written.

training.weather: ERA5 daily (production training recipe; no forecast archive before 2024-01-19)
training.hyper_parameters: fte.OLD_PARAMS unchanged; early stopping on the last 60 training rows only

reference_observed_weather_NOT_REALISTIC.note: uses ERA5 weather of the target day (not available at 23:00 IST); upper-bound reference and coverage check only
